parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The list of primary key identifiers to be synchronized to Certificate Management Service. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and the received message. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: NoticeBiz
parameters.description: The business code of message notification. The value is fixed as ssl.

parameters.name: NoticeStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable message notification.
\--enable: enables message notification.
\--disable: disables message notification.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
